references.title: Invite a customer modal
references.question: Q2
references.take: Podia’s Invite a customer modal captures email entry, optional tags, a time-limited access warning, and explicit Don’t invite/Invite customer actions; targeted enrolment evidence, but no role selector or access code/link is visible.

references.title: Course ready sharing confirmation
references.question: Q5
references.take: Canva’s post-publish confirmation says Your course is ready, notes team notification, and offers Go to Classwork plus Copy link; strong feedback that sharing/publishing succeeded, without pending/accepted learner counts.
